name: Google Glass
what_failed: Consumer augmented reality headset that became a cultural punchline despite genuine technical achievement.
assumptions_that_broke: People want a screen in front of their face all day
Early adopters will tolerate social stigma
Technology enthusiasts represent the mass market
AR is wanted by consumers before enterprise
constraints_that_moved: AR found enterprise niche (manufacturing, surgery, logistics)
Social norms around wearables shifted (AirPods precedent)
lesson: Consumer AR failed because it was sold as a lifestyle product when it was actually a productivity tool. Enterprise-first, consumer-later.
